message:
test: measure the capture against a GPU window, and state the identity limit's worst case

Test 2, build 1. No product change. Both additions were checkpoints the reviewer named.

The deadline table was five GDI windows that differed only in size, which stopped being the
interesting variable the moment the capture turned out to be served from the DWM redirection
surface rather than by the application. So the fixture grew two more kinds: a layered window,
and a window presenting through a flip-model D3D11 swapchain -- what a game or an emulator
looks like to DWM, and the presentation mode already known here to put a window out of GDI's
reach (viewer ledger F-21, the 0.2.123 picker fix).

The GPU window costs what a GDI window of the same size costs. 1920x1080 flip-model: 33.1ms
median against 33.3ms for plain GDI, across four runs, with the worst single sample 41.6ms
against 37.1ms. Layered at 1280x800 matches plain GDI at 1280x800 to within a millisecond. The
cost tracks pixel count and nothing else, which is what a surface copy plus a StretchBlt
downscale should look like.

That is the answer the deadline needed. A one second deadline is about twenty five times the
worst sample of the most expensive window type measured.

Still not measured: real applications. UWP cannot be created by this test at all, and pointing
the probe at the user's running windows is out of scope by instruction. What can be said is
that the two surface types most likely to be expensive are not.

The other two checks close the identity limit. The suite showed that a same-process HWND reuse
inherits a cooldown, and showed separately that leaving the window list clears one, but never
walked the path where neither happens -- so the size of the worst case was asserted nowhere.
It is one cooldown: the replacement is skipped, becomes eligible again after sixty seconds, and
one success clears the record.

And the mitigations only compose in one order. A TTL shorter than a cooldown would drop the
entry mid-skip and send the window straight back to being asked, which is the thing the
cooldown exists to stop. Nothing asserted the two were ordered; now the relation is checked and
so is an entry surviving a sweep taken while its cooldown runs.
